title: Rebuilding the knowledge index after recording an observation makes that observation stale
symptom: A case observation recorded current becomes historical (stale-revision-or-inputs) once knowledge/INDEX.md is rebuilt to list it, which the verify lane's library index --check requires
trigger: chough cases run <case> (or evidence add), then chough library index, with the librarian on (the default)
expected: Recording another observation does not self-invalidate the content identity (REQ-cli-004 AC2): the generated knowledge index that lists observations does not make them stale
actual: knowledge/INDEX.md lists the most recent observations and is inside the working content identity, so the rebuild that lists a new observation changes the identity and every observation recorded before it reads historical; at a PR head that passes library index --check, no observation recorded on that branch is current
steps: Record TC-cli-native-check-safe-verifying with chough cases run on 01aebd6c: status reads it current (environment-unchecked)
Run chough library index: knowledge/INDEX.md gains the observation's line
Run chough status: the observation reads historical, freshness stale-revision-or-inputs; restoring INDEX.md makes it current again
impact: Branch observations read historical at the reviewed head (seen on C4, #126, at 01aebd6c); reviewers must rerun or discount them

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: BUG-0015 (#10) was committing .chough records, fixed by excluding .chough/ from the content identity; this one is the generated knowledge/ directory (KNOW-1, default on since #106), which lists observations and is still inside the identity
Filed as GitHub issue CorvidLabs/chough#136 at Leif's request (2026-11-05 20:58 MST, through the orc).

status: open -> investigating. Reproduced on failing-tests commit e659153c through TC-cli-knowledge-rebuild-keeps-observation-current: the observation reads historical after chough library index lists it.
status: investigating -> verified. Passes after the fix (knowledge directory left out of the content identity) through the same case.
